analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive day. RSI is hovering around 43.1 in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram shows improvement (-848.9915 to 94.7976) but remains in a bearish convergence. The weekly ADX at 27.0 indicates a clear trend, but the daily directionality is absent. Volume at 1.16 times the 5-day average is normal. The price is consolidating between the swing support of 29,960 KRW and resistance of 30,570 KRW, searching for direction.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (30,440 KRW) vs SMA5 (30,606 KRW)/SMA20 (32,699 KRW)/SMA50 (34,713 KRW): diagnosed as below short-term, below mid-term, and below long-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 (38,106 KRW)/SMA200 (36,275 KRW): confirmed weak mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (34.3%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (34.1→43.1): exited oversold territory and continuing in neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-848.9915→94.7976): confirmed improvement, bearish convergence ongoing.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 32,699 KRW): consolidating around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (29,960 KRW): above Pivot S1 (24,795 KRW), below moving averages (SMA5).
· Swing Resistance (30,570 KRW): potential for short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: sideways range, no clear Higher Low or Lower High formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.16x): normal reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, exploring direction. Consider buying on a breakout above 30,570 KRW resistance, consider selling on a break below 29,960 KRW support.
